name: Jade Dildo
source:
Yes! Famous Jack Wells is on duty again!

His boss gives him a new task: to investigate the case of the stolen Jade Dildo from the Eleanor collection. In pursuit of the truth, Jack will visit a night club and competitive collector, and will discover secrets leading him far to the East.

You need to use your detective's intuition if you want to solve this case or... or you will be used by your boss Sally as a sex toy. Hmm...

That doesn't sound so bad, right?
